lhs: Apply a static positive-stride slice to the output of an arbitrary paired-axis Int dot.
rhs: Apply each projected slice on each changed operand, retaining every contracting dimension whole, then dot with the original paired-axis order.
conditions: Arbitrary well-formed operand role permutations, legal natural start/limit/positive stride, compatible paired batch and contraction extents; source guards and profitability only restrict dispatch. Shows both projected shapes and all admitted output values.
types: Static logical tensors of exact mathematical Int, arbitrary batch/free/contract ranks and extents, Cartesian contraction.
overlap: Dynamic constant lookup moves the opposite direction in a rank-two singleton subcase. Zero-pad dot changes contraction supports. Projected slice/broadcast has no summation or second operand. No independent increment for the two operand orientations or output axes.

lhs: Reduce both free axes with add/zero after dot pairs lhs contracting axes [1,2] to rhs [2,1].
rhs: Reduce axis 0 of each operand first; reconstruct each new contracting list in its physical dimension order [0,1] and dot to a scalar.
conditions: Layout-insensitive, enabled option, threshold two, no batches, static operand shapes [m,2,2] and [n,2,2], scalar output, nonempty and nontrivial reduction. The witness m=n=3 satisfies the strict profitability comparison 80/24>2.
types: Exact Int; every witness intermediate fits S32; ordinary dense dot and additive zero-seeded reductions.
overlap: The HandleReduce call invokes the same profitable helper. Distinct from stale partner dimension numbers after broadcast/dot and from sum distributivity with preserved contraction pairing.

lhs: Slice a leading unit-stride interval from a row-major reshape.
rhs: Generate the pre-reshape rectangular operand slice by the minor-to-major quotient/remainder loop and reshape it to the sliced result.
conditions: Matched element counts, valid interval, successful construction with positive input-axis divisors. Empty results allowed. All output addresses and generated axis bounds checked.
types: Arbitrary element type and rank, static logical natural extents and offsets.
overlap: Builds the complete box and proves every address. Neither slice composition nor reshape cardinality suffices. Caller and callee count once.

lhs: Transpose a simplified single-base, single-update scatter.
rhs: Transpose the base and window axes, preserve the entry axis, remap indexed axes by the inverse permutation and scatter.
conditions: Common arbitrary entry schedule and update operation, unbatched simplified scatter, signed origins and whole-window drop. Physical layout and write-run cost are outside the equality.
types: Arbitrary element type, arbitrary finite rank and natural extents, including zero, and typed output positions.
overlap: Transports index-vector destinations and update windows together. Existing raw elementwise-drop and common-update maps have different operators. Caller delegates to callee.

lhs: Take pointwise wrapping absolute value of a signed integral Iota.
conditions: Width w=k+2; at every coordinate equality holds iff the other-coordinate type is empty or the Iota extent is at most 2^(w−1)+1. Source selects signed Iota only in the sufficient nonnegative range, including the int64 extent bound for wide words.
types: Wrapping two’s-complement words with arbitrary other-axis coordinate type and Fin n Iota coordinate.
overlap: Only the signed-Iota producer variant. Other Iota laws alter dimension generation or reduce indices, and do not characterize abs. The first excluded index is a sharpness control outside the source guard.
